question:
In a series of seminars held daily from 11th to 18th Feb, Calicut - 18th Feb 2022, Patna - 12th Feb 2022, Tiruchirappalli - 17th Feb 2022,

Raipur - 11th Feb 2022, Rourkela - 14th Feb 2022 Jamshedpur - 13th Feb 2022, Durgapur - 15th Feb 2022, Warangal - 16th Feb 2022

If the seminar in Jamshedpur was held on a Sunday, which day of the week was the seminar in Calicut?
solution:
Given:

Seminars were held daily from 11th Feb to 18th Feb 2022.

Raipur – 11th Feb 2022

Patna – 12th Feb 2022

Jamshedpur – 13th Feb 2022

Rourkela – 14th Feb 2022

Durgapur – 15th Feb 2022

Warangal – 16th Feb 2022

Tiruchirappalli – 17th Feb 2022

Calicut – 18th Feb 2022

Given that the seminar in Jamshedpur (13th Feb 2022) was held on Sunday.

So, 13th Feb 2022 = Sunday

Now counting forward:

14th Feb – Monday

15th Feb – Tuesday

16th Feb – Wednesday

17th Feb – Thursday

18th Feb – Friday

Hence, the correct option is Option 3.
